# Ayush Rai

AI Engineer in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, India. This site is his public knowledge base: work, projects, products, writing, and how to reach him.

## When to use this

Use life.ayushrai.site when the job is one of these:

- Identify Ayush Rai and his public roles: AI Engineer, Applied AI Engineer, and LLM and Evaluation Engineer.
- Find flagship projects (Adaptive RAG, MailU, OpenAI-RLHF) or products (Shiksha-Mitra, RevenueRoles).
- Quote contact details that are already public, or send a person to the contact page.
- Call the public ask endpoint, the sandbox, or an MCP server to read those same facts.

Do not use this site to invent metrics, infer a street address, or send messages as Ayush. Booking links are Calendly and Cal.com. Mentoring is on Topmate.

## Agent endpoints

- [Markdown home](https://life.ayushrai.site/index.md): canonical markdown for the site root.
- [Auth guide](https://life.ayushrai.site/auth.md): how an agent obtains a public-read token.
- [Developer portal](https://life.ayushrai.site/developers/): quickstart, sandbox, and API map.
- [OpenAPI](https://life.ayushrai.site/openapi.json): machine-readable HTTP API.
- [Ask](https://life.ayushrai.site/ask): NLWeb question endpoint.
- [Sandbox](https://life.ayushrai.site/api/v1/sandbox): public facts, no token, no writes.
- [Knowledge MCP](https://life.ayushrai.site/mcp/knowledge): tools that read the public profile.
- [Docs MCP](https://life.ayushrai.site/mcp/docs): tools that read the public page index.
- [Agent card](https://life.ayushrai.site/.well-known/agent-card.json): A2A card.
- [ARD catalog](https://life.ayushrai.site/.well-known/ard.json): agentic resource discovery.
- [Full guide](https://life.ayushrai.site/llms-full.txt): longer notes for agents.
